summary_1line: Dhritarashtra questions Yudhishthira about righteous kingship, and the ascetic Vidura mystically transfers his life-force into Yudhishthira through yogic power.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a lonely forest clearing, the emaciated ascetic Vidura leans against a tree while his gaze fixes on Yudhishthira and his life-force mystically enters the king.
Yudhishthira runs through the deep forest calling out to the gaunt, naked Vidura with matted locks as the hermit flees among the trees.
Vidura, skeletal and dust-covered with matted hair, stands motionless against a tree in meditation while Yudhishthira approaches reverently.
